जगद्धात्री: she who holds the world. 🦁✨

A form of Durga, seated on a lion that stands over an elephant. Celebrated in Bengal since the 18th century, and nowhere brighter than in Chandannagar, whose light artists are famous across India.

Jagaddhatri Puja: 16–19 November. Navami: Wednesday 18 November.

Have you seen Chandannagar's lights in person? Tag the friend you'd go with 👇
